name: Spell Failure Table — Attack Spells
rollMatchPolicy: rollMin / rollMax inclusive on a plain (non-open-ended) d100 + modifiers. Bands run to 301+; rolls above the top band clamp to it.

elemental.text: That gnat just landed in your ear. You must begin casting the spell again (but do not lose the power points).

force.text: Your target's grace distracts you. You lose the spell (and one power point).

elemental.text: Your fingertips spark and surprise you. You lose the spell (and one power point). You operate at a -50 modification next round.

force.text: You remember a childhood incident that was traumatizing. You lose the spell (but not the power points). Operate at -10 for five rounds.

elemental.text: Minor power backlash. You lose the spell (and half the number of power points — rounded down). Stunned for 1 round.

force.text: The magic blurs your vision. You lose the spell (and half the number of power points — rounded down). Stunned for 1 round.

elemental.text: You realize you are casting the wrong spell. You must start over. Lose the power points.

force.text: The planets are not aligned correctly! Your spell has absolutely no effect (and you lose the power points).

elemental.text: You feel a spider crawling up your back! You lose the spell and the power points.

force.text: Your target must be blessed! Your spell has no effect and you lose double the normal number of power points.

elemental.text: The spell fails! Flames roll down your arm. You take 5 hits and are stunned for 3 rounds.

force.text: Power backlash! The spell fails entirely. You are stunned for 8 rounds.

elemental.text: The elements refuse your call! You are knocked back 3 feet (taking 2d10 hits), and are stunned for six rounds.

force.text: The target's will is stronger than yours! You collapse on the ground (taking d10 hits) and are stunned for 9 rounds.

elemental.text: Instead of launching, the elements engulf you. Take 20 hits and a 'B' critical strike.

force.text: The spell internalizes. You take 4d10 hits and are knocked unconscious for 12 hours.

elemental.text: The elemental attack strays to the right of the intended target. You are stunned for three rounds.

force.text: The spell affects a random target to the right of the intended target. You are stunned for one round and take d10 hits (from the mental strain).

elemental.text: An unforeseen cosmic shift causes the spell to veer to the left of the target (striking the nearest target). This sudden change causes mental strain; take 5 hits and you are stunned for one round.

force.text: You lose control and the spell hits a target to the left of the intended target. Make another attack against a random target within range. You are stunned for one round and take d10 hits from the wild attack.

elemental.text: You get the polarity backwards! The elements travel 180° from the intended direction (hitting any available target). In the wake, you take 5d10 hits and a 'C' critical strike.

force.text: The spell targets a random victim that can be anywhere within 500'. The power backlash short circuits your brain. Take 25 hits and are unable to function for d10 hours.

elemental.text: The elements cannot be controlled! Your brain is fried (lose all spell casting ability for 1 week). You operate at -50 for 3 months (or until brain is repaired).

force.text: The spell lodges in your head. You suffer brain damage; you operate at a -75 modification for d10 months (or until brain is repaired). You lose all spell casting ability for 1 week.

elemental.text: The spell explodes immediately as you cast it! Make a point blank attack on yourself. You are in a coma for 1 week (and lose spell casting ability for 2 weeks).

force.text: The spell misfires and internalizes inside your head. Take 35 hits. You lose spell casting ability for d10 weeks. There is a 40% chance of falling into a d10 day coma.

elemental.text: The elements attack you. Take 10d10 hits and d10 'C' critical strikes. After the assault, you will fall into a coma for 5 weeks. After the coma, you will seem fine; but will die 6 hours later.

force.text: You suffer a massive stroke! Take 10d10 hits and fall into a month-long coma. At the end of the coma, you will seem fine; but will die d10 hours later.

elemental.text: The power is too much to control. The elements refuse to rise to your command. The spell internalizes and paralyzes your torso.

force.text: The spell completely short circuits your nervous system. You are paralyzed from the waist down.

elemental.text: The elements control you! Take 8d10 concussion hits and d10 'E' critical strikes. After displaying your failure, you will fall into a coma for 3 weeks (and lose spell casting ability for d10 weeks).

force.text: The spell completely internalizes. You lose all spell casting ability for d10 weeks and will be in a coma for d10 weeks. Take 8d10 hits.

elemental.text: You slip into the elemental planes for d10 rounds. When you return, you realize that you have lost all your spell casting ability for d10 months.

force.text: Severe nervous disorder causes you to lose all your spell casting ability for d10 months.

elemental.text: All of the elements visit you at once. All that is left is a charred mass of flesh.

force.text: Massive internalization of spell. Instant brain death.
